blocks.model: Persistently low fertility can affect the size of the future workforce as smaller generations reach working age. If fewer workers enter employment while demand for services remains high, organisations may face recruitment difficulties and governments may need to reconsider how public commitments are financed. These pressures develop over time, so they are different from an immediate shortage caused by a brief change in employment. Their scale also depends on productivity, migration and participation rates. Demographic change therefore creates a need for adjustment, rather than determining a single unavoidable economic outcome.
blocks.guide: 加入时间滞后及生产率等调节因素，防止人口预测决定论。

blocks.title: S3C 较晚育儿与准备程度
blocks.name: 较晚育儿与准备程度
blocks.chain: time to establish resources and priorities → more preparation → potential benefits for family stability
blocks.model: Having children later may bring advantages when the additional time allows parents to establish financial stability and clarify their responsibilities. They may have accumulated savings, developed more predictable work arrangements or gained experience in managing a household. These resources can make some aspects of parenting easier to organise. However, the benefit comes from the preparation itself and cannot be assumed from age alone. Some younger parents have strong support, while some older parents remain under substantial pressure. The quality of the circumstances surrounding parenthood is therefore more informative than a simple age comparison.
blocks.guide: 将年龄与真正发挥作用的准备程度分开，适合写非绝对化比较。

topics.description: 解释生育推迟、育儿准备与未来人口结构。

topics.title: S4 Migration and Urbanisation 人口流动与城市化
topics.name: 人口流动与城市化

blocks.title: S4A 流动与岗位匹配
blocks.name: 流动与岗位匹配
blocks.chain: workers move towards suitable vacancies → skills used more productively → income opportunities
blocks.model: Migration can improve economic opportunities by allowing people to move towards places where their skills are needed. A qualified worker may find few relevant vacancies in one area but be able to fill a shortage elsewhere. This movement can increase the worker's income while helping an employer carry out activities that would otherwise be constrained by a lack of staff. The benefit depends on realistic access to employment, housing and appropriate recognition of qualifications. Without these conditions, the potential value of better labour matching may remain difficult for migrants to realise.
blocks.guide: 同时解释迁出者与接收地的收益，并限定机会能否兑现。

blocks.title: S4B 城市人口与设施滞后
blocks.name: 城市人口与设施滞后
blocks.chain: rapid inflow → demand grows faster than capacity → housing and service pressure
blocks.model: Rapid urban growth can create pressure when housing and public services take longer to expand than the population. Newly arrived residents need accommodation, transport and access to schools, but building facilities and training staff require time. If supply cannot respond quickly enough, rents may rise and existing services may become crowded. The problem concerns the pace of adjustment rather than the presence of newcomers alone. Planning for likely population changes and investing in capacity can reduce these difficulties while allowing a city to benefit from additional workers and economic activity.
blocks.guide: 核心变量是增长速度与扩容速度不匹配，不将迁入群体本身视为问题。

blocks.title: S4C 人才外流与回流收益
blocks.name: 人才外流与回流收益
blocks.chain: skilled workers leave → local shortages → remittances and returning knowledge may partly offset losses
blocks.model: Migration can create difficulties for places that lose workers with skills that are already scarce. A community may struggle to maintain essential services if experienced professionals leave faster than replacements can be trained. The effects are not entirely one-directional, however. Migrants may send money to relatives or later return with useful knowledge and professional contacts. These contributions can support the place of origin, although they may not replace the missing service directly. A balanced assessment should therefore distinguish the immediate loss of capacity from the different benefits that may arise over time.
blocks.guide: 区分不同类型和不同时间的得失，避免汇款自动抵消人才流失。

topics.description: 比较岗位匹配、城市承载与人才流动。

topics.title: S5 Community and Public Spaces 社区与公共空间
topics.name: 社区与公共空间

blocks.title: S5A 重复接触与社区信任
blocks.name: 重复接触与社区信任
blocks.chain: accessible meeting places → repeated informal contact → familiarity and trust → mutual support
blocks.model: Public spaces can strengthen community ties by creating opportunities for repeated, informal contact. Residents who regularly visit the same park or community centre may begin by recognising one another and gradually develop conversations or shared activities. This familiarity can make it easier to ask for help or take part in local initiatives. The social benefit therefore emerges through patterns of use, rather than from the physical space alone. Safe surroundings, convenient access and activities that welcome different groups make it more likely that residents will return and form these connections.
blocks.guide: 补出重复接触到熟悉再到信任的过程，适用于 third place。

blocks.title: S5B 免费设施与平等参与
blocks.name: 免费设施与平等参与
blocks.chain: participation does not require substantial payment → financial barriers fall → wider access to leisure and exercise
blocks.model: Free public facilities can reduce inequality in access to recreation. Commercial gyms or private venues may offer attractive services, but regular fees can exclude households with limited disposable income. A well-maintained public park gives residents a place to exercise, relax and meet others without making each visit a financial decision. This can broaden participation across income groups. Equal access still requires attention to practical details, including transport links, safe opening hours and facilities for people with different mobility needs. Removing the entrance fee is an important step, but it is only one part of accessibility.
blocks.guide: 免费解决支付门槛，地理和身体条件仍需分别处理。

topics.description: 用共同空间和日常接触解释社区信任。

topics.title: S6 Lifestyle Change 生活方式变化迁移
topics.name: 生活方式变化迁移

blocks.title: S6A 便利与日常时间分配
blocks.name: 便利与日常时间分配
blocks.chain: routine transactions become easier → time and effort saved → other commitments become more manageable
blocks.model: Changes in lifestyle can improve well-being when convenient services reduce the effort required for necessary tasks. Someone who completes routine banking or shopping without an additional journey may have more time for family responsibilities or study. The benefit is particularly meaningful when daily schedules are already constrained. However, the value of convenience depends partly on how the released time is used and whether important forms of contact disappear. Assessing a lifestyle change therefore requires attention to the wider routine it creates, including both the tasks it simplifies and the experiences it may replace.
blocks.guide: 将 T2 和 P2 迁移到日常生活，比较被节省与被替代的内容。

blocks.title: S6B 更换习惯与耐用消费
blocks.name: 更换习惯与耐用消费
blocks.chain: replacement normalised → repair considered less often → usable products discarded → wasteful routines reinforced
blocks.model: Frequent replacement can gradually change how people think about ownership. If buying a new item becomes the usual response to a minor fault, consumers may stop considering whether the existing product could be repaired. This expectation can make durability and maintenance seem less important at the point of purchase, reinforcing a pattern of short product lives. Affordable repairs and clear information about spare parts can interrupt the cycle by making continued use a practical option. The aim is to change the routine surrounding a purchase as well as the decision made when something breaks.
blocks.guide: 将 EN3 的成本逻辑迁移到习惯形成，形成行为与预期的循环解释。

topics.description: 分析便利、时间安排与耐用消费的变化。

topics.title: H1 Diet and Public Health 饮食与公共健康
topics.name: 饮食与公共健康

blocks.title: H1A 环境如何影响饮食
blocks.name: 环境如何影响饮食
blocks.chain: prices availability and marketing → practical food choices → repeated dietary patterns → health implications
blocks.model: Dietary choices are influenced by the options people encounter in daily life. A household with limited time and money may find convenient, inexpensive meals easier to obtain than alternatives requiring more preparation or a longer journey. Repeated marketing can also make particular products more visible and familiar. These conditions shape habits, even though individuals still make the final decision. Public health policies are therefore more likely to be useful when they address affordability and availability alongside information. Telling people what to eat has limited practical value if suitable choices remain difficult to obtain.
blocks.guide: 从实际选择条件解释习惯，避免把健康问题全部归因于自律。

blocks.title: H1B 健康干预与共同成本
blocks.name: 健康干预与共同成本
blocks.chain: preventable ill health → costs shared through public services → proportionate intervention has a public rationale
blocks.model: Governments have a reason to address unhealthy dietary patterns when their consequences place demands on services financed by the wider population. The effects of individual choices may then extend beyond the person making them. Clear nutrition information and restrictions on misleading claims can help people assess products more accurately, while well-designed incentives may make healthier alternatives more attractive. The response should remain proportionate to the problem and sensitive to household circumstances. This approach recognises a public interest in prevention while preserving meaningful room for personal choice.
blocks.guide: 先解释为什么是公共问题，再说明信息和激励如何保留选择空间。

topics.description: 从食品环境、行为选择与共同成本讨论健康。

topics.title: H2 Sedentary Lifestyle 久坐生活方式
topics.name: 久坐生活方式

blocks.title: H2A 日常安排与活动减少
blocks.name: 日常安排与活动减少
blocks.chain: work study and leisure organised around sitting → movement opportunities shrink → inactivity becomes routine
blocks.model: A sedentary lifestyle can develop when several parts of the day require little physical movement. Someone may travel by car, work at a desk and then spend the evening using digital entertainment. Each decision can seem reasonable in isolation, yet together they leave few regular opportunities to be active. Demanding schedules can make additional exercise feel difficult to arrange. Understanding this pattern helps explain why awareness alone may not change behaviour. People are more likely to move regularly when activity becomes a practical part of ordinary journeys, work breaks or accessible leisure routines.
blocks.guide: 把不同场景累积起来解释日常模式，再提出嵌入式改变。

blocks.title: H2B 降低运动的实际门槛
blocks.name: 降低运动的实际门槛
blocks.chain: safer routes and accessible facilities → less time effort or cost required → regular activity becomes feasible
blocks.model: Public facilities can encourage physical activity by reducing the inconvenience involved in taking part. A safe walking route near home or an affordable sports centre may allow residents to exercise without making a lengthy additional journey. For people with limited free time, this difference can determine whether participation is realistic. Facilities should also be available at useful times and designed for different users. The mechanism is therefore practical as well as motivational: improving access changes how easily an intention to be active can be translated into a regular habit.
blocks.guide: 将意愿到行动之间的时间成本补出来，使设施投资的论证更具体。

topics.description: 解释活动为何减少，以及怎样让运动更可行。

topics.title: H3 Healthcare Funding 医疗筹资
topics.name: 医疗筹资

blocks.title: H3A 风险共担与就医机会
blocks.name: 风险共担与就医机会
blocks.chain: contributions pooled → large individual costs shared → access less dependent on immediate resources
blocks.model: Pooling healthcare funding can make access to treatment less dependent on a person's ability to meet a large bill at the moment care is needed. Individuals contribute through an agreed system, and the collected resources support those who require services. This arrangement spreads costs across a wider group and can reduce the financial barrier to seeking help. Its fairness depends on how contributions and eligibility are organised. Public financing can also work with different types of provider, so deciding who pays is a separate question from deciding who operates every clinic or hospital.
blocks.guide: 解释费用为何可被分担，并区分筹资与提供服务。

blocks.title: H3B 服务能力与财政压力
blocks.name: 服务能力与财政压力
blocks.chain: demand exceeds available staff and resources → waiting and workload increase → capacity or funding must adjust
blocks.model: A healthcare system may face long delays when the demand for services exceeds the capacity of available staff and facilities. Providing financial coverage does not immediately create additional professionals or treatment spaces. If commitments expand without corresponding resources, patients may wait longer and employees may face unsustainable workloads. Governments must therefore consider both funding and the practical ability to deliver care. These pressures can arise under different organisational arrangements, so explaining them requires attention to demand, staffing and management rather than assuming that one form of ownership is always inefficient.
blocks.guide: 将有支付保障与有实际服务能力分开，准确定位等待的原因。

topics.description: 比较风险共担、就医机会与服务能力。

topics.title: H4 Ageing and Care 老龄化与照护迁移
topics.name: 老龄化与照护迁移

blocks.title: H4A 社区支持与照护衔接
blocks.name: 社区支持与照护衔接
blocks.chain: everyday assistance available → manageable difficulties addressed early → independence supported and family pressure reduced
blocks.model: Community care can help older people remain independent when they need assistance with particular daily tasks rather than constant supervision. Help with transport, meals or routine appointments may make it possible to continue living in familiar surroundings. Families can also benefit when responsibility is shared with reliable local services instead of resting on one relative. The arrangement must match the person's actual needs and include a way to obtain more intensive support when required. Its value lies in providing appropriate assistance at the right level, rather than assuming that every older person needs the same type of care.
blocks.guide: 将 S1 与 H3 迁移到照护方式，明确社区服务解决的是哪些任务。

topics.description: 将社区支持迁移到老人照护与服务衔接。

topics.title: H5 Appearance and Cosmetic Procedures 外貌与整容
topics.name: 外貌与整容

blocks.title: H5A 理想化形象与不安全感
blocks.name: 理想化形象与不安全感
blocks.chain: selective idealised images → repeated upward comparison → perceived inadequacy → demand for change
blocks.model: Repeated exposure to idealised appearances may increase dissatisfaction by changing the standard against which people judge themselves. Carefully selected images can make unusually polished looks seem ordinary, while concealing the preparation or editing behind them. A person comparing everyday appearance with this selective material may consequently focus on perceived shortcomings. Products or procedures promising improvement can then become more attractive. The influence varies between individuals, but the mechanism helps explain how dissatisfaction may be shaped by the surrounding media environment rather than arising entirely from an independent assessment of personal preferences.
blocks.guide: 解释参照标准怎样改变；不用媒体使所有人焦虑的绝对表述。

blocks.title: H5B 外貌选择与长期满足
blocks.name: 外貌选择与长期满足
blocks.chain: desired change achieved → possible satisfaction → continued comparison may limit lasting benefit
blocks.model: Choosing to change one's appearance may provide satisfaction when the decision reflects a clear and stable personal preference. Some people may feel more comfortable after addressing a feature that has concerned them for a long time. However, the outcome is less certain when dissatisfaction is continually renewed by comparison with other people. Altering one feature may leave the underlying standard unchanged, allowing attention to shift to another perceived flaw. A balanced discussion should therefore distinguish the freedom to make an appearance-related choice from the assumption that such a choice will necessarily produce lasting confidence.
blocks.guide: 将改变外貌与改变评价标准区分开，保留个体差异。

topics.description: 区分外貌比较、个人选择与长期满足。

topics.title: EN1 Animals 动物福利与物种保护
topics.name: 动物福利与物种保护

blocks.title: EN1A 人类用途与必要性
blocks.name: 人类用途与必要性
blocks.chain: particular use may provide human benefits → necessity and alternatives assessed → limited justification
blocks.model: Some uses of animals can be defended on the grounds that they provide important benefits which are difficult to obtain by other means. Food production and certain forms of research are often discussed in this way. However, the strength of the argument depends on the specific purpose and on whether an effective alternative is available. A minor convenience offers a weaker justification for harm than an essential need. Evaluating each use in terms of necessity, expected benefit and avoidable suffering allows a more careful judgement than approving every practice simply because humans gain something from it.
blocks.guide: 人类收益必须进一步比较必要性和替代方案；这是价值论证而非经验因果。

blocks.title: EN1B 动物痛苦与道德考虑
blocks.name: 动物痛苦与道德考虑
blocks.chain: animals can experience suffering → their treatment has moral significance → avoidable harm should be limited
blocks.model: Animal welfare deserves consideration because the capacity to suffer gives an animal's treatment moral importance beyond its usefulness to humans. A practice may be profitable or convenient while still causing harm that could reasonably be avoided. This provides a basis for requiring appropriate conditions and examining less harmful alternatives. The argument does not depend on treating every species or every situation as identical. It asks whether the benefit is substantial enough to justify the harm and whether those responsible have taken reasonable steps to reduce unnecessary suffering.
blocks.guide: 说明伦理判断的依据，避免把保护动物只写成对人类有用。

blocks.title: EN1C 生物多样性与生态功能
blocks.name: 生物多样性与生态功能
blocks.chain: species interact → loss disrupts ecological relationships → environmental functions may weaken
blocks.model: Protecting species can also be important because organisms form part of ecological relationships that support wider environmental functions. Plants, pollinators and other animals interact in ways that contribute to reproduction, food supplies and the functioning of habitats. The loss of a species can therefore affect more than the organism that disappears. Some consequences may be difficult to reverse once a relationship has been disrupted. This ecological argument supports attention to habitats and biodiversity, while remaining distinct from the welfare question of how individual animals are treated within a particular human activity.
blocks.guide: 区分物种层面的生态关系与个体层面的痛苦，避免概念混用。

topics.description: 比较人类用途、动物痛苦与生态系统功能。

topics.title: EN2 Transport and Pollution 交通与污染
topics.name: 交通与污染

blocks.title: EN2A 出行活动与排放
blocks.name: 出行活动与排放
blocks.chain: journeys require energy → fuel combustion produces emissions → costs extend beyond travellers
blocks.model: Transport creates environmental costs when everyday mobility depends heavily on burning fossil fuels. The person making a journey benefits from reaching a destination, but the resulting emissions can affect people who had no role in that decision. When these wider costs are not reflected in the price of travel, individuals have less financial reason to reduce them. This helps explain the case for cleaner systems and appropriate incentives. Policy must still recognise that many journeys are necessary, making the availability of realistic alternatives central to an effective response.
blocks.guide: 明确私人收益与外部成本的承担者，便于连接 G4。

blocks.title: EN2B 可行替代与减排
blocks.name: 可行替代与减排
blocks.chain: lower-emission journeys become practical → existing travel behaviour changes → emissions may decline
blocks.model: Cleaner transport options are most useful when they can replace journeys that people already make by more polluting means. A bus service that is frequent and well connected may attract commuters who would otherwise drive, while a safe route can make walking realistic for shorter trips. The environmental gain comes from this change in behaviour. Providing an option that is inconvenient or inaccessible may generate little substitution. Authorities should therefore consider the full journey, including waiting time and connections, when designing measures intended to reduce transport-related emissions.
blocks.guide: 把新增设施到减排之间的换乘行为写出来。

topics.description: 把出行方式、替代选择与排放联系起来。

topics.title: EN3 Repair and Replace 维修更换与废弃物
topics.name: 维修更换与废弃物

blocks.title: EN3A 为何选择更换
blocks.name: 为何选择更换
blocks.chain: replacement is cheap and easy while repair is costly → replacement preferred → usable goods discarded
blocks.model: Consumers may replace products because repairing them appears more expensive or inconvenient than buying a new item. A minor fault can still require the owner to locate a technician, wait for a spare part and pay a service charge. Meanwhile, a replacement may be available immediately at a similar price. Under these conditions, choosing a new product can seem reasonable from the individual's perspective, even when the old one remains repairable. The wider result is premature disposal and additional production, which explains why changing the economics and convenience of repair matters.
blocks.guide: 正确比较维修与更换的相对成本，区分个体合理与社会成本。

blocks.title: EN3B 延长寿命与减少资源需求
blocks.name: 延长寿命与减少资源需求
blocks.chain: repair is accessible → products used longer → fewer replacements needed → material use and waste reduced
blocks.model: Making repair easier can reduce waste by extending the useful life of products. If spare parts are available and a common fault can be fixed at a reasonable price, owners have a practical reason to continue using an item. Fewer replacements are then required over the same period, reducing the demand for new materials and the number of discarded goods. Durable design supports the same outcome by preventing avoidable failures. The strongest policies address both the design of the product and the services that allow owners to maintain it after purchase.
blocks.guide: 以相同使用时段内减少更换次数解释资源节约。

blocks.title: EN3C 更换是否可能更环保
blocks.name: 更换是否可能更环保
blocks.chain: new production has costs but old use may be inefficient → total lifetime effects compared → context-specific decision
blocks.model: Repairing an old product is not always the option with the lowest overall environmental cost. Keeping an item in use avoids the materials required for a replacement, but an unusually inefficient appliance may consume substantial energy throughout its remaining life. A newer model could reduce that continuing demand, although manufacturing it also has an environmental impact. The decision therefore requires a comparison across production, use and disposal. This approach prevents a simple preference for either repair or replacement from overlooking the stage at which most of the relevant cost actually occurs.
blocks.guide: 加入全生命周期比较，不把某一阶段的节约当作总收益。

topics.description: 权衡维修、更换、使用效率与资源需求。

topics.title: EN4 Energy 能源
topics.name: 能源

blocks.title: EN4A 可靠供应与基本活动
blocks.name: 可靠供应与基本活动
blocks.chain: dependable affordable energy → essential services and production continue → economic and social stability
blocks.model: A dependable energy supply is necessary for activities on which households and businesses rely. Interruptions can disrupt production, prevent equipment from operating and make essential services difficult to deliver. Affordability also matters, since high and unpredictable costs can place pressure on ordinary budgets and business planning. Energy policy must therefore consider whether a system can provide sufficient power when it is needed. This requirement supports careful management of any transition between sources, with attention to infrastructure and continuity alongside the long-term environmental objectives that make change desirable.
blocks.guide: 说明可靠性服务于哪些具体活动，再引入转型节奏。

blocks.title: EN4B 化石能源与长期成本
blocks.name: 化石能源与长期成本
blocks.chain: continued fuel combustion → accumulated emissions → environmental costs extend into the future
blocks.model: Continued dependence on fossil fuels can create costs that are not fully visible in the immediate price of energy. Burning these fuels releases emissions, while investments in long-lived equipment can make the same pattern of consumption difficult to change later. A system that appears economical in the short term may therefore commit society to continuing environmental damage and future adjustment costs. This provides a reason to develop alternatives before existing infrastructure reaches a point of failure. The pace of change should consider reliability, but immediate convenience alone is an incomplete basis for energy decisions.
blocks.guide: 用设备寿命解释路径锁定，将今天的决策连接未来成本。

blocks.title: EN4C 多样化与能源安全
blocks.name: 多样化与能源安全
blocks.chain: heavy reliance on one source or supplier → vulnerability to disruption → diversified capacity improves resilience
blocks.model: Energy security depends partly on how vulnerable a system is to disruption in a particular source or supply route. A country relying heavily on one supplier may face serious difficulties if that relationship is interrupted. Diversifying sources and strengthening infrastructure can reduce the chance that a single problem prevents essential activities from continuing. Domestic resources may help, but their availability alone does not settle the question, since systems also need adequate capacity and dependable delivery. Security should therefore be assessed through the structure of supply rather than attached automatically to one type of fuel.
blocks.guide: 区分燃料类别与供给结构，避免化石能源天然安全的判断。

topics.description: 比较可靠供能、长期成本与能源多样化。

topics.title: EN5 Local Food 本地食物
topics.name: 本地食物

blocks.title: EN5A 较短供应链的潜在收益
blocks.name: 较短供应链的潜在收益
blocks.chain: suitable local production → shorter routes and closer trading relationships → potential savings and local support
blocks.model: Locally produced food can offer advantages when suitable products reach consumers through an efficient, relatively short supply chain. Less transport may be required, and nearby buyers can provide farmers with a more direct market for their goods. This connection can support local businesses and make consumers more aware of how food is produced. The environmental benefit, however, depends on the way the food is grown, stored and delivered. Local purchasing has a stronger case when it combines shorter journeys with production methods that suit the region's natural conditions.
blocks.guide: 支持本地食物时保留适宜生产条件，避免距离单因素。

blocks.title: EN5B 生产效率与整体判断
blocks.name: 生产效率与整体判断
blocks.chain: unsuitable growing conditions → additional energy or resources → transport savings may be outweighed
blocks.model: Food produced nearby is not necessarily more environmentally efficient than food brought from farther away. A crop grown outside its suitable conditions may require substantial heating, irrigation or other inputs. Producing the same crop in a region with a favourable climate could use fewer resources, even after transport is included. Storage losses and the method of delivery also influence the comparison. The most useful judgement therefore considers the complete supply chain. Geographical distance is one relevant factor, but it cannot substitute for an assessment of how the food is actually produced and handled.
blocks.guide: 用可理解的温室或资源投入解释反例，不需要编造排放数据。

topics.description: 从供应链和生产效率判断本地食物的影响。

topics.title: EN6 Growth and Environment 经济增长与环境
topics.name: 经济增长与环境

blocks.title: EN6A 增长与减贫能力
blocks.name: 增长与减贫能力
blocks.chain: productive activity expands → income jobs and revenue → greater capacity to improve living conditions
blocks.model: Economic growth can support poverty reduction when it creates productive jobs and increases the resources available for essential services. Employment gives households a source of income, while a larger tax base may allow governments to improve education, infrastructure and social protection. These changes can make better living conditions more attainable. However, the connection is not automatic: additional wealth may be concentrated among people who already have substantial resources. The case for growth is strongest when its benefits reach disadvantaged groups and the resulting public revenue is used effectively.
blocks.guide: 收入和财政能力是中间机制，收益分配是成立条件。

blocks.title: EN6B 环境成本与长期繁荣
blocks.name: 环境成本与长期繁荣
blocks.chain: resource-intensive growth with unpriced harm → degradation → future costs undermine prosperity
blocks.model: Growth can undermine future prosperity when it relies on environmental damage whose costs are ignored in current decisions. A business may increase output while leaving the wider community to deal with polluted surroundings or depleted resources. The immediate value of production then gives an incomplete picture of the activity's contribution to welfare. Over time, restoring damaged systems or replacing lost resources may require substantial expenditure. Environmental rules and incentives can help bring these costs into present decisions, encouraging firms to seek improvements that generate economic value without continuing the same level of harm.
blocks.guide: 解释环境损害怎样反过来损害经济福利，避免只并列增长与污染。

topics.description: 比较增长的减贫能力与环境成本。

topics.title: CUL1 Advertising 广告
topics.name: 广告

blocks.title: CUL1A 产品信息与选择
blocks.name: 产品信息与选择
blocks.chain: useful product information → search effort reduced → alternatives compared → better matching
blocks.model: Advertising can help consumers make informed choices when it communicates relevant differences between products. Someone purchasing an unfamiliar item may otherwise have to spend considerable time discovering which options exist and what they offer. Clear information about features or prices makes comparison easier and may help a smaller business reach potential customers. The benefit depends on the accuracy and usefulness of the message. A persuasive campaign that conceals limitations may increase sales without improving the decision, so the informational function of advertising should be assessed separately from its commercial success.
blocks.guide: 从搜索成本说明广告价值，并区分销量增加与选择改善。

blocks.title: CUL1B 理想生活与额外消费
blocks.name: 理想生活与额外消费
blocks.chain: products associated with admired identities → perceived personal gap → purchases pursued for recognition
blocks.model: Advertising can encourage unnecessary consumption by connecting products with an attractive image of success or belonging. A message may suggest that owning a particular item will make someone more admired, even when the product offers little practical improvement over what they already possess. Consumers who compare themselves with this ideal may begin to experience dissatisfaction that a purchase appears able to resolve. The resulting demand is partly driven by the promise of identity rather than functional need. This mechanism is especially relevant when discussing fashion, popular brands and the social meaning attached to ownership.
blocks.guide: 解释商品如何与身份联系，避免直接说广告洗脑。

topics.description: 区分产品信息与理想化生活带来的消费诱导。

topics.title: CUL2 Media 媒体
topics.name: 媒体

blocks.title: CUL2A 调查报道与问责
blocks.name: 调查报道与问责
blocks.chain: hidden conduct investigated → reliable information reaches public → scrutiny → pressure for accountability
blocks.model: Independent reporting can improve public accountability by bringing significant information to people who would otherwise be unable to obtain it. An investigation may explain how a decision was made, who benefited and whether public commitments were respected. Citizens can then evaluate officials or institutions on a more informed basis and demand explanations where necessary. This function relies on verification and the freedom to examine powerful interests. Publishing an accusation without adequate support can damage trust, so the value of the media as a watchdog depends on careful evidence as well as willingness to investigate.
blocks.guide: 补出公众获得信息后如何形成监督，强调证据要求。

blocks.title: CUL2B 注意力竞争与风险感知
blocks.name: 注意力竞争与风险感知
blocks.chain: attention rewarded → dramatic stories selected repeatedly → perceived frequency or importance distorted
blocks.model: Media coverage can distort people's understanding when dramatic events receive attention far beyond their wider significance. Stories involving conflict or unusual danger may attract an audience more easily than ordinary developments, giving publishers a reason to feature them repeatedly. A reader exposed to this selection may come to believe that such events are typical, even when the coverage provides little context for comparison. The problem concerns how information is selected and presented. More careful reporting and media literacy can help audiences distinguish the prominence of a story from evidence about how common it actually is.
blocks.guide: 区分曝光频率与真实发生频率，可迁移到网络信息。

topics.description: 比较公共监督、注意力竞争与风险感知。

topics.title: CUL3 Celebrity and Privacy 名人与隐私
topics.name: 名人与隐私

blocks.title: CUL3A 公共影响与合理审视
blocks.name: 公共影响与合理审视
blocks.chain: influential conduct affects others → public has a relevant stake → proportionate scrutiny justified
blocks.model: Public figures may reasonably face scrutiny when their conduct affects the interests of others. A celebrity who promotes a product or uses influence to support a public cause can shape decisions made by a large audience. Information about the honesty of those claims may therefore help people assess whether the influence is being used responsibly. The justification comes from a connection to public consequences. It is weaker when a story reveals private details that do little to clarify any relevant action, decision or position of trust.
blocks.guide: 公共审视的依据是他人利益，而不是名气本身。

blocks.title: CUL3B 商业曝光与隐私边界
blocks.name: 商业曝光与隐私边界
blocks.chain: selective public exposure does not cover every private activity → unrestricted intrusion imposes harm → boundaries needed
blocks.model: Earning money through a public image does not mean that a person has agreed to unlimited intrusion into private life. A performer may choose to discuss a project while reasonably expecting family members or private conversations to remain outside that arrangement. Persistent attention can also affect people who did not choose a public career themselves. A defensible boundary should therefore consider the relevance of the information and the methods used to obtain it. Public curiosity alone provides a limited justification for exposing details that do not contribute to understanding a matter of wider importance.
blocks.guide: 区分选择公开的范围和旁人的权利，适用于隐私类反驳。

topics.description: 辨析公共利益相关审视与商业曝光的边界。

topics.title: CUL4 Foreign Culture and Convergence 外来文化与文化趋同
topics.name: 外来文化与文化趋同

blocks.title: CUL4A 接触不同叙事与理解
blocks.name: 接触不同叙事与理解
blocks.chain: foreign stories and practices encountered → assumptions compared → broader cultural understanding
blocks.model: Exposure to foreign culture can broaden understanding by allowing people to encounter experiences that differ from their own. A film or book may show how another community interprets family responsibilities, social expectations or personal success. Comparing these perspectives can reveal that familiar arrangements are not the only possible ones. Shared cultural references may also make international conversation easier. The benefit is greater when audiences engage thoughtfully with the material, since simply consuming a foreign product does not guarantee an accurate understanding of the society from which it comes.
blocks.guide: 说明具体比较了什么价值与经验，并限定接触不等于理解。

blocks.title: CUL4B 渠道集中与本土创作
blocks.name: 渠道集中与本土创作
blocks.chain: dominant global distribution → local creators receive less attention and revenue → diversity becomes harder to sustain
blocks.model: Cultural diversity may weaken when a small number of global producers dominate the channels through which audiences discover content. Local creators can struggle to obtain visibility even when their work reflects experiences that larger companies overlook. Limited attention reduces potential revenue, making future production harder to finance. Over time, fewer distinctive stories may reach the public. This concern is more precise than assuming that every foreign influence damages local identity. The issue is whether audiences continue to have practical access to a varied range of local and international voices.
blocks.guide: 将同质化落在传播渠道与创作资金上，避免文化接触必然侵蚀身份。

topics.description: 比较多元文化接触与本土创作空间。

topics.title: CUL5 Tangible Heritage 物质文化遗产
topics.name: 物质文化遗产

blocks.title: CUL5A 历史载体与文化连续性
blocks.name: 历史载体与文化连续性
blocks.chain: visible historical objects preserved → past becomes accessible → education and shared identity
blocks.model: Historical buildings and artefacts can connect a community with experiences that would otherwise remain abstract. A preserved site allows residents and visitors to see how earlier generations lived, worked or organised public life. This physical connection can support education and give people a clearer sense of continuity with the place they inhabit. Visitors may also create income for surrounding businesses. These benefits provide reasons for preservation, although their strength varies between sites. Decisions should consider historical significance and public use as well as the resources required to maintain the structure.
blocks.guide: 用看得见的历史如何帮助理解来展开文化价值，再考虑具体遗产差异。

blocks.title: CUL5B 适应性再利用与成本
blocks.name: 适应性再利用与成本
blocks.chain: unused heritage requires maintenance → suitable new use generates participation and support → preservation becomes more viable
blocks.model: Adapting a historic building to a suitable modern use can make preservation more sustainable. An empty structure may continue to require repairs while offering few opportunities for public participation. If it becomes a library, cultural venue or another useful facility, regular use can strengthen the case for maintaining it and may help cover some costs. The adaptation must still protect the features that give the building its significance. This approach treats preservation as an ongoing relationship between historical value and present needs, allowing continuity without requiring every original function to remain unchanged.
blocks.guide: 将保护与发展结合在同一机制中，具体说明新用途的作用。

topics.description: 连接历史价值、当代用途与保护成本。

topics.title: CUL6 Intangible Heritage 非物质文化遗产
topics.name: 非物质文化遗产

blocks.title: CUL6A 语言习俗与归属
blocks.name: 语言习俗与归属
blocks.chain: practices transmitted through participation → shared memories and meanings → belonging across generations
blocks.model: Languages and customs can maintain a sense of belonging by giving people shared ways to express experiences and remember the past. Participating in a familiar celebration or learning expressions used by older relatives creates opportunities for stories and values to pass between generations. These experiences may help individuals understand their place within a wider community. Continuity depends on active use, however, rather than simply declaring a tradition important. Teaching, participation and room for meaningful interpretation make it more likely that younger generations will find a reason to carry a practice forward.
blocks.guide: 强调实践与参与如何完成代际传承，避免仅列 identity 和 belonging。

blocks.title: CUL6B 传统适应与当代影响
blocks.name: 传统适应与当代影响
blocks.chain: social conditions change → some practices impose new or continuing harms → adaptation preserves value while reducing harm
blocks.model: Traditions should be considered in relation to their effects on people living today. A practice may preserve a meaningful connection with the past while also placing unfair restrictions on some members of the community. Its age does not settle whether those restrictions remain justified. Examining the purpose of the custom can help distinguish valuable elements from features that could be changed. Adaptation may then allow people to maintain shared identity without continuing avoidable harm. This offers a reasoned basis for reform that recognises both cultural continuity and the needs of current participants.
blocks.guide: 找到传统的目的与具体做法之间的区别，支持有选择的调整。

topics.description: 讨论文化归属、代际传承与传统适应。

topics.title: CUL7 Economic Globalisation 经济全球化
topics.name: 经济全球化

blocks.title: CUL7A 专业化与更广市场
blocks.name: 专业化与更广市场
blocks.chain: larger markets and specialisation → more efficient production → potential price and choice benefits
blocks.model: International trade can benefit consumers by allowing producers to specialise and serve a larger market. A business able to spread certain costs across more customers may offer goods more efficiently, while access to foreign suppliers can increase the range of available products. Competition may also encourage existing firms to improve quality or pricing. These gains depend on effective market conditions and do not reach every household equally. Nevertheless, the mechanism explains why restricting trade can carry costs for consumers as well as offering protection to particular domestic producers.
blocks.guide: 补出规模与成本之间的关系，区分总体收益和分配。

blocks.title: CUL7B 调整成本与地区差异
blocks.name: 调整成本与地区差异
blocks.chain: stronger external competition → some firms contract → concentrated job losses → adjustment support needed
blocks.model: The benefits of globalisation can coexist with serious losses in particular communities. When a local industry faces competition it cannot match, firms may reduce employment even as consumers elsewhere gain access to cheaper goods. Workers who have spent years developing specialised experience may find it difficult to move into a different occupation or location. The overall gain therefore does not remove the need to address concentrated adjustment costs. Relevant training, assistance with transition and realistic local opportunities can help affected people participate in the benefits of economic change.
blocks.guide: 同时观察收益分散和损失集中，比只写全球化造成失业更精确。

topics.description: 权衡更广市场、专业化与地区调整成本。

topics.title: CUL8 Arts Education 艺术教育
topics.name: 艺术教育

blocks.title: CUL8A 普及艺术与个人发展
blocks.name: 普及艺术与个人发展
blocks.chain: creative participation → experimentation and expression → wider personal abilities
blocks.model: Basic arts education can benefit people who have no intention of becoming professional artists. Creating a drawing or musical piece requires choices about how an idea or feeling will be expressed. Trying different approaches and responding to feedback can develop attention, imagination and a willingness to experiment. Participation may also give learners a practical understanding of cultural works they encounter elsewhere. These purposes justify access beyond a small group with obvious early talent. The educational aim at this level is meaningful engagement and development, rather than selecting only those likely to pursue an artistic career.
blocks.guide: 解释普通参与者能获得什么，区分普及教育与职业培养目标。

blocks.title: CUL8B 专业培养与公平选拔
blocks.name: 专业培养与公平选拔
blocks.chain: advanced training requires intensive support → resources directed towards potential and commitment → high standards with fair access
blocks.model: Professional arts training may reasonably use selection because advanced study requires intensive instruction and sustained practice. Institutions with limited places need evidence that applicants can benefit from the programme and are prepared for its demands. Demonstrated ability and commitment are relevant, but previous access to lessons can strongly affect how developed that ability appears. Fair selection should therefore consider potential as well as current polish. Providing broad introductory opportunities alongside selective advanced training allows professional standards to be maintained without treating early disadvantage as proof that someone lacks artistic capacity.
blocks.guide: 把当前表现与潜力分开，避免将资源优势误判为天赋。

topics.description: 区分普遍艺术参与和专业培养的目标。

topics.title: CUL9 International Travel 国际旅行
topics.name: 国际旅行

blocks.title: CUL9A 直接接触与刻板印象
blocks.name: 直接接触与刻板印象
blocks.chain: meaningful contact → variation within another society becomes visible → assumptions reconsidered
blocks.model: International travel can encourage cultural understanding when visitors engage with people and everyday activities beyond a narrow tourist setting. Direct conversation may reveal differences between individuals that a simplified media image leaves out. A traveller who encounters varied opinions and ways of living has a reason to reconsider assumptions about an entire country. The experience can therefore make cultural judgements more careful and specific. This outcome is less likely if travel consists mainly of familiar services and brief observation, so the quality of contact matters alongside the fact of crossing a border.
blocks.guide: 补出接触内容和理解更新过程，避免出国自动开阔眼界。

blocks.title: CUL9B 游客消费与当地收益
blocks.name: 游客消费与当地收益
blocks.chain: visitors purchase local services → demand and income rise → business and employment opportunities
blocks.model: Tourism can support local economies when visitors buy services supplied by businesses in the destination. Spending on accommodation, food or guided activities can create demand that the resident population alone would not sustain. This may allow firms to employ additional staff and provide opportunities for small producers. The size of the local benefit depends on how much income remains in the community and how stable the demand is across the year. A destination that relies heavily on imported goods or outside operators may retain less value than visitor spending totals initially suggest.
blocks.guide: 区分游客总支出与本地实际留存收益，并考虑季节性。

blocks.title: CUL9C 过度旅游与承载能力
blocks.name: 过度旅游与承载能力
blocks.chain: visitor demand exceeds local capacity → crowding resource and housing pressures → resident welfare affected
blocks.model: Tourism can reduce residents' quality of life when visitor demand grows beyond the capacity of local facilities. Crowded transport and public spaces may make ordinary activities more difficult, while accommodation aimed at tourists can compete with other uses of housing. Waste and resource demand can also increase during peak periods, and journeys to the destination carry environmental costs of their own. The effects depend on visitor numbers, timing and management. Evaluating tourism therefore requires attention to the costs borne by residents alongside the revenue received by businesses serving travellers.
blocks.guide: 明确成本由居民承担、收入由哪些经营者获得，并加入旅行本身的环境影响。

topics.description: 比较跨文化理解、当地收益与旅游承载力。

topics.title: P1 Wealth and Happiness 财富与幸福
topics.name: 财富与幸福

blocks.title: P1A 收入与物质安全
blocks.name: 收入与物质安全
blocks.chain: essential needs met → uncertainty and practical restrictions reduced → well-being may improve
blocks.model: Higher income can improve well-being when it helps people meet needs that were previously insecure. Being able to pay for stable housing, reliable transport or an unexpected expense reduces the pressure attached to ordinary decisions. Additional resources may also open opportunities for education and participation that were previously unaffordable. The benefit is therefore especially clear when money removes a significant constraint on daily life. Its size will vary with costs and personal circumstances, so the relationship is better explained through the needs being met than through a single income figure applied to everyone.
blocks.guide: 收入通过缓解哪种约束产生收益，比钱买幸福的抽象表述更有效。

blocks.title: P1B 适应与相对比较
blocks.name: 适应与相对比较
blocks.chain: improved conditions become familiar → expectations rise or comparisons change → satisfaction gains may weaken
blocks.model: Additional wealth may bring less lasting satisfaction when people adapt to their improved circumstances. A more expensive possession can initially feel rewarding but gradually become an ordinary part of life. At the same time, comparing oneself with wealthier peers may shift attention towards what is still missing. These processes can explain why rising consumption does not always produce a similar increase in contentment. They do not make income irrelevant, particularly where essential needs remain unmet, but they show why relationships, purpose and the standards used for comparison also matter.
blocks.guide: 用适应和比较解释收益减弱，避免编造统一幸福门槛。

topics.description: 区分基本物质保障、适应与相对比较。

topics.title: P2 Instant Gratification 即时满足
topics.name: 即时满足

blocks.title: P2A 便利与时间价值
blocks.name: 便利与时间价值
blocks.chain: waiting and routine effort reduced → time becomes available → other responsibilities easier to meet
blocks.model: The desire for quick access can be reasonable when convenience helps people manage limited time. Completing a necessary transaction online may remove a journey or a long wait, allowing a parent to collect a child or a worker to attend a class. In such cases, speed serves an existing priority and can improve the organisation of daily life. The advantage should be evaluated in relation to what becomes possible with the time saved. Convenient services are most valuable when they support meaningful activities or necessary responsibilities rather than simply creating additional demands for attention.
blocks.guide: 用节省时间后的具体用途支持便利，避免即时需求总是浅薄的判断。

blocks.title: P2B 即时奖励与长期成本
blocks.name: 即时奖励与长期成本
blocks.chain: immediate benefit receives attention → delayed costs underweighted → impulsive decisions accumulate
blocks.model: Immediate rewards can encourage poor decisions when their appeal makes future costs easy to overlook. A purchase completed with very little effort may provide a brief sense of satisfaction, while the effect on a monthly budget or the need to dispose of another item feels distant. Repeating this pattern can create costs that were not obvious in any single decision. The problem is therefore the balance of attention given to present and future consequences. Allowing time to compare options and making later costs more visible can support more deliberate choices.
blocks.guide: 写出成本为什么被忽略及如何累积，适用于购物与更换产品。

topics.description: 权衡即刻便利和需要持续投入的长期目标。

topics.title: P3 Technological Dependence 科技依赖
topics.name: 科技依赖

blocks.title: P3A 外包任务与技能弱化
blocks.name: 外包任务与技能弱化
blocks.chain: independent tasks repeatedly outsourced → less practice → unaided performance may weaken
blocks.model: Dependence on technology can weaken an ability when the tool repeatedly replaces the practice needed to maintain it. Someone who always follows navigation instructions may reach destinations efficiently without paying much attention to the relationships between places. If the service becomes unavailable, travelling independently may then be more difficult. The risk arises from the pattern of use rather than from the mere presence of the device. Retaining opportunities to make decisions, recall information and check an answer independently can help users preserve the abilities that convenience might otherwise allow them to neglect.
blocks.guide: 明确练习减少这个中间机制，避免使用技术直接导致能力下降。

blocks.title: P3B 工具反馈与能力提升
blocks.name: 工具反馈与能力提升
blocks.chain: tools expose errors and guide practice → users revise their own work → independent capability improves
blocks.model: Technology can strengthen human capability when it supports active practice instead of completing every task on the user's behalf. A learning tool that identifies an error and asks the student to revise an explanation creates an opportunity to understand the problem. The student must still make the correction and evaluate whether it works. Repeated use of this process may improve future performance even without the tool. The educational value therefore depends on how responsibility is divided between the user and the system, with greater benefits when assistance preserves meaningful thinking and decision-making.
blocks.guide: 对照 P3A，改变人机任务分工即可改变结果方向。

topics.description: 比较技能外包与技术反馈对能力的不同影响。

topics.title: P4 Ambition and Competition 抱负与竞争
topics.name: 抱负与竞争

blocks.title: P4A 目标与持续努力
blocks.name: 目标与持续努力
blocks.chain: meaningful goal → progress monitored → practice sustained → mastery and achievement
blocks.model: Ambition can support achievement by giving people a reason to persist through difficult stages of learning. A clear and personally meaningful goal helps an individual decide which activities deserve attention and whether current efforts are producing progress. Small improvements can then encourage further practice, even when the final result remains distant. This process is more sustainable when goals are challenging but adjustable in response to experience. The benefit comes from directing effort towards development, rather than from assuming that wanting a high level of success is sufficient to produce it.
blocks.guide: 目标通过注意力分配与进度反馈促进努力，别把愿望直接等同成果。

blocks.title: P4B 排名与失去边界的追求
blocks.name: 排名与失去边界的追求
blocks.chain: self-worth tied to relative position → progress never feels sufficient → rest and cooperation sacrificed
blocks.model: Ambition can become damaging when people judge their worth entirely by whether they rank above others. Personal progress may offer little satisfaction if someone else still appears more successful. The individual may then work beyond sustainable limits or treat cooperation as a threat to their position. This can strain relationships and reduce opportunities for recovery. The problem is especially difficult when the standard of success continually moves. Keeping achievement connected to meaningful goals and recognising responsibilities outside competition can make effort more sustainable without requiring people to abandon the desire to improve.
blocks.guide: 用相对标准不断移动解释不满足和过度投入，区别正常上进。

topics.description: 解释目标、持续努力和排名压力的作用。

topics.title: P5 Consumer Psychology 消费心理迁移
topics.name: 消费心理迁移

blocks.title: P5A 比较与重复购买
blocks.name: 比较与重复购买
blocks.chain: idealised messages create a perceived gap → purchase offers temporary relief → comparison renews dissatisfaction
blocks.model: Consumer dissatisfaction can become self-reinforcing when purchases are used to resolve feelings created by social comparison. An advertisement or a peer's possession may suggest that an individual lacks something associated with success. Buying the item can briefly reduce this feeling, but exposure to a new standard may create another perceived gap. The result is a sequence of purchases that provides limited lasting reassurance. This explains why the psychological effects of marketing may extend beyond any single sale and why reflecting on the purpose of a purchase can change the decision.
blocks.guide: 将 CUL1 与 P1 P2 组合成循环，但保持一条主线。

topics.description: 把社会比较迁移到重复购买与消费判断。

topics.title: P6 Peer Validation 同伴认可
topics.name: 同伴认可

blocks.title: P6A 积极规范与归属
blocks.name: 积极规范与归属
blocks.chain: acceptance valued → constructive group norms adopted → effort and participation encouraged
blocks.model: Peer influence can support development when belonging to a group encourages constructive behaviour. A student whose friends value preparation and mutual assistance may be more willing to complete difficult work or ask for help. Participation provides social recognition, making useful habits rewarding in more than an academic sense. Shared activities can also give young people practice in cooperation and resolving disagreements. The benefit comes from the norms that the group reinforces, so the desire for acceptance should not automatically be treated as a weakness or as an influence that is always harmful.
blocks.guide: 同伴认可本身没有固定方向，先说明群体奖励什么行为。

blocks.title: P6B 排斥恐惧与冒险行为
blocks.name: 排斥恐惧与冒险行为
blocks.chain: belonging feels threatened → disagreement becomes costly → harmful behaviour imitated
blocks.model: Peer pressure can weaken judgement when a young person believes that disagreeing with friends will lead to exclusion. An activity that seems unwise in private may become difficult to refuse if participation is treated as proof of loyalty or maturity. The immediate social cost of saying no can then outweigh attention to possible consequences. This helps explain why information about risks may be insufficient on its own. Supportive relationships and opportunities to practise refusing unreasonable demands can make independent decisions more feasible without leaving the young person feeling completely isolated.
blocks.guide: 用拒绝的社交成本解释明知不当仍模仿，避免只说青少年不理性。

topics.description: 区分积极规范与害怕排斥带来的冒险行为。

topics.title: P7 Freedom and Responsibility 自由与责任迁移
topics.name: 自由与责任迁移

blocks.title: P7A 自主选择与干预边界
blocks.name: 自主选择与干预边界
blocks.chain: personal decisions may affect others → relevant harm assessed → proportionate responsibility and intervention
blocks.model: Personal freedom is important because adults have different priorities and should normally be able to organise their own lives. The argument for intervention becomes stronger, however, when a decision creates substantial costs for other people who cannot reasonably avoid them. The appropriate response should be connected to that harm and should preserve as much choice as possible. Providing accurate information may be sufficient in some situations, while stronger rules may be justified in others. Judging the scale and distribution of the consequences offers a clearer basis for policy than defending either complete freedom or unrestricted government control.
blocks.guide: 将 G5 迁移到价值判断，说明干预强度如何随外部影响调整。

topics.description: 依据外部影响划定自主选择与责任的范围。

topics.title: V1 Autonomy and Collective Welfare 自主与共同利益
topics.name: 自主与共同利益

blocks.title: V1A 以外部影响划定干预范围
blocks.name: 以外部影响划定干预范围
blocks.chain: freedom has value → effects on others examined → intervention matched to the harm
blocks.model: The balance between personal autonomy and collective welfare should depend on how a choice affects people beyond the decision-maker. When the consequences are largely private and adults have reliable information, there is a strong reason to preserve individual discretion. Where substantial harm falls on others, public intervention has a clearer purpose. Even then, the measure should be proportionate and its effects should be assessed. This principle allows governments to protect shared interests while requiring them to explain why a particular restriction is necessary and how it addresses the relevant problem.
blocks.guide: 可接 G4 H1 P7；先划私人影响与外部影响，再判断措施强度。

topics.description: 用外部影响与比例原则判断干预是否合理。

topics.title: V2 Equity and Incentives 公平与激励
topics.name: 公平与激励

blocks.title: V2A 扩大机会并保留努力回报
blocks.name: 扩大机会并保留努力回报
blocks.chain: unequal starting conditions addressed → meaningful participation expands → rewards still recognise contribution
blocks.model: Fairness and incentives can be pursued together when policy distinguishes starting opportunities from later achievements. People may need additional support to obtain education or meet essential needs before they can participate effectively. Once these barriers are reduced, rewards can still recognise effort, responsibility and useful contribution. Treating everyone as if they began with the same resources may preserve an appearance of equal rules while leaving substantial disadvantages untouched. A more convincing balance therefore combines access to opportunity with transparent expectations about performance and a reasonable return on additional effort.
blocks.guide: 可接 E3 W6 G3；不要把公平直接定义为所有结果一样。

topics.description: 在扩大起点机会的同时保留努力回报。

topics.title: V3 Present Needs and Future Benefits 当前需要与未来收益
topics.name: 当前需要与未来收益

blocks.title: V3A 让长期论证具备可检验路径
blocks.name: 让长期论证具备可检验路径
blocks.chain: immediate need compared with plausible future return → timing and uncertainty considered → spending priority justified
blocks.model: Long-term benefits deserve weight in public decisions, but their importance must be explained through a plausible path from investment to outcome. A proposal is more convincing when it identifies who will use the resulting capacity and how the benefit will continue over time. Immediate needs also matter, especially when delay would create serious and avoidable harm. The appropriate balance therefore depends on urgency, uncertainty and the availability of alternative ways to achieve the same purpose. This makes the reasoning more specific than assuming that either present difficulties or future possibilities should always take priority.
blocks.guide: 可接 T5 G1 EN4；对未来收益追问使用者、实现路径与时间。

topics.description: 比较紧迫性、不确定性与长期收益的实现路径。

topics.title: V4 Security and Privacy 安全与隐私
topics.name: 安全与隐私

blocks.title: V4A 以必要性和监督约束数据使用
blocks.name: 以必要性和监督约束数据使用
blocks.chain: specific security purpose → relevant data identified → safeguards limit unrelated intrusion
blocks.model: Security measures are easier to justify when the information collected is clearly connected to a defined risk. Authorities should be able to explain what the data is needed for, who may use it and how errors or misuse can be challenged. These requirements limit the possibility that a narrow protective purpose becomes a reason for unrestricted monitoring. Privacy protection can therefore strengthen the legitimacy of a security system rather than merely obstruct its operation. The balance depends on necessity and accountability, with greater intrusion requiring a correspondingly stronger explanation of its public value.
blocks.guide: 可接 T4 C4；将抽象平衡变成用途、权限与申诉三个具体判断。

topics.description: 以用途、权限和申诉机制约束数据使用。

topics.title: V5 Preservation and Adaptation 保护与适应
topics.name: 保护与适应

blocks.title: V5A 区分核心价值与可变形式
blocks.name: 区分核心价值与可变形式
blocks.chain: meaningful features identified → unnecessary constraints adapted → continuity remains relevant
blocks.model: Cultural preservation is more sustainable when people distinguish the value they wish to retain from the exact form in which it has previously appeared. A building may preserve historical significance while serving a new public function, and a custom may retain shared meaning while changing an exclusionary rule. Adaptation can make continued participation more attractive to current users. However, changes should be assessed carefully so that the qualities being protected are not gradually removed. This approach allows continuity to remain relevant instead of requiring communities to choose between complete replacement and an unchanged past.
